sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Minute of Fame is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Sup, bandit! How's life? A little birdie told me there's a special magazine in the Ultra mall at the Interchange. They wrote about our Russian video game, which is recognized all over the world! I guess the guys really came up with a great concept!"

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - This quest is only available to buyers of the "Edge of Darkness" edition of the game.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Locate and obtain the special edition of the gaming magazine on Interchange
- Hand over the found item

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +28,000 EXP
- 1,600 Euros
  - 1,680 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 1,840 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 2× AWC Thor PSR XL multi-caliber sound suppressor
- 2× AR-10 AWC PSR 7.62x51 muzzle brake
- 2× SIG Sauer SRD762Ti 7.62x51 sound suppressor
- Unlocks Dirty Hideout ceiling style
"Now this is a victory! The magazine hit the jackpot! Looks like real historical shit."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| Gaming magazine | 1 | Handover item | Yes | This quest item can only be found if the quest is active.; When picked up, this item is transferred to the player's quest item inventory.; If the player fails to extract with this item, they will lose it. |
The magazine can be found on the second floor of the ULTRA shopping mall on Interchange, in a book store called "МУЗЕЙ ИСТОРИИ" ("Museum of History"). There are multiple spawns throughout the store.

sections.heading: First spawn
sections.text: On one of the billard tables.

sections.heading: Second spawn
sections.text: In the trash can in the men's restroom.

sections.heading: Third spawn
sections.text: On the floor in the band room, second to last seating row.

sections.heading: Fourth spawn
sections.text: On the floor beneath the bookshelf next to the band room.

sections.heading: Fifth spawn
sections.text: On the round table next to the train.

sections.heading: Sixth/Seventh spawn
sections.text: On both sides of the center bookshelf closest to the arcade machines.

sections.heading: Eighth/Ninth spawn
sections.text: On both sides of the center bookshelf closest to the restroom.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: The magazine referenced in this quest is issue #216 of the Russian computer games magazine "Навигатор игрового мира" (Game World Navigator).
